prompts.name: 01 · 사선 베일
prompts.prompt: Create a NEW independent variation of this abstract background reference, matching its restrained smoky charcoal and thin champagne-gold light aesthetic. This is a background bitmap ONLY, to overlay across an elegant ALDEBARAN website header 1920x88px; do not include any website, text, logo, controls, icons, borders or frame. Wide landscape 3:1 image. Fine luminous gold filaments, extremely translucent smoky glass veils, deep charcoal negative space. The UI example uses a dark central navigation area and wisps concentrated near the edges: preserve that sober visual balance. Keep 70 percent of the image almost black, gold very muted and desaturated, controlled subtle light rather than shiny metallic surfaces. Avoid satin or brushed metal, chunky ribbons, dense meshes, dot patterns, glitter, particles, bright flares and sculpted 3D thickness. Make the upper third an effective shallow header crop with fine flowing details visible at its left and right and calm darkness across its middle. Variation 01: several fine oblique translucent folds rise softly from the far left lower edge toward the top around the first quarter, then dissolve into darkness. A restrained echo of two gold filaments enters from the far right upper corner. Asymmetric framing, very quiet middle. Sparse overlapping wisps, narrow highlights, softly feathered edges.
